vb_textbox.text: There are 2 different color sets of Gnomes. Red, purple, pink, and brown will take you to a RED basket. Continue to select these Gnomes to go with a RED basket until the number of mushrooms decreased. Then switch over to the other set of Gnomes which will take you to an ORANGE basket. Continue with the same basket color until the number of mushrooms decreases again.
